hosted_context_measured_by_coordinator.root_cause: run_worker constructed PostgresLifecycleSource(include_non_lifecycle=True) and project_records wrote disposition='ignored' receipts for every heartbeat and infrastructure_health event, even after LIFECYCLE-COMMITTED-FRONTIER-20261006 (f235cf2f6) moved checkpoint advancement to the writer-fenced source frontier.

runtime_budget.cadence: Event-driven per committed lifecycle batch (1s poll interval + pantheon_lifecycle_events LISTEN/NOTIFY wakeup); non-lifecycle events produce 0 receipt writes in live worker mode.

cap.lifecycle_receipts_retained: permanent (bounded by lifecycle event rate: <= 73,000 rows / <= 16.5 MB per year at full 3-persona daily cycle)

cleanup.predicate: disposition = 'ignored' AND NOT (source_event_type = ANY(LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPES)) AND ingested_seq <= min_controller_checkpoint_seq AND journey_id = '' AND loop_run_id = ''
cleanup.filesystem_reclaim: Handled on hosted by the reclaim script extended in TELEMETRY-INFRA-HEALTH-RETENTION-20261117 (scripts/telemetry_heartbeat_reclaim.py not modified here).

changes.live_worker_source_filter: run_worker builds PostgresLifecycleSource(include_non_lifecycle=False) by default (configurable via LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_INCLUDE_NON_LIFECYCLE for rollback); fetch_after queries WHERE ingested_seq > $1 AND event_type = ANY(LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPE_QUERY) and establishes last_frontier_seq = max(row_frontier, COALESCE(MAX(ingested_seq), 0)) under _source_writer_fence whenever len(rows) < limit.
changes.projector_receipt_suppression: RelationalLifecycleProjector.project_records skips appending EventReceiptRow for non-lifecycle event types when a proven source_frontier_seq > 0 is supplied (unless persist_non_lifecycle_receipts=True), while preserving receipts permanently for all LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPES (applied, quarantined, and superseded-retry ignored).
changes.callers_without_proven_frontier: _backfill CLI (backfill and replay commands) passes source_frontier_seq=0 by default and keeps writing ignored receipts so the contiguous CTE advances checkpoint_seq; lifecycle_projector_capacity.run_capacity_benchmark supplies source_frontier_seq=high_watermark.
changes.pruning_job: ProjectionStore.prune_non_lifecycle_receipts, prune_non_lifecycle_receipts_on_connection, run_non_lifecycle_receipt_prune, NonLifecycleReceiptPruneJob, and lifecycle_projector.py prune-receipts CLI delete existing non-lifecycle ignored receipts at or below the minimum controller checkpoint in bounded batches under transaction-local statement_timeout.
changes.redundant_index_drop_migration: services/trade_journey/migrations/002_drop_redundant_event_receipts_index.sql drops trade_journey_projection.idx_event_receipts_ingested_seq while keeping the UNIQUE constraint index event_receipts_ingested_seq_key on (ingested_seq).

event_receipts_readers_inventory.query: SELECT ... FROM event_receipts WHERE event_id = ANY(%s)
event_receipts_readers_inventory.compatibility: Queries by event_id PK; unaffected by pruning non-lifecycle ignored receipts <= checkpoint_seq or dropping idx_event_receipts_ingested_seq.

event_receipts_readers_inventory.query: SELECT event_id, fingerprint FROM event_receipts WHERE event_id = ANY(%s)
event_receipts_readers_inventory.compatibility: Checks fingerprint conflicts and idempotent retries for lifecycle receipts (retained permanently).

event_receipts_readers_inventory.query: WITH RECURSIVE contiguous(seq) AS (...) SELECT MAX(seq) FROM contiguous; plus proven_frontier = mutation.source_frontier_seq
event_receipts_readers_inventory.compatibility: Starts at curr_checkpoint_seq and steps forward (> curr_checkpoint_seq) using event_receipts_ingested_seq_key; proven_frontier advances checkpoint_seq across sequence holes left by skipped types and heartbeat retention.

event_receipts_readers_inventory.index_used: table/index scan during one-time legacy baseline seed before live controller exists
event_receipts_readers_inventory.compatibility: Pruning refuses to delete any row when no controller checkpoint > 0 exists (safe_ingested_seq = 0).
Supplies source_frontier_seq=high_watermark in run_capacity_benchmark; all 10 fault scenarios pass.

hosted_shape_13_7m_benchmark_measurement.dataset_description: PostgreSQL 16 database seeded with 13,710,000 existing event_receipts rows (250 historical lifecycle receipts across applied, quarantined, and superseded-retry ignored dispositions + 13,709,750 ignored heartbeat and infrastructure_health receipts through ingested_seq=13,710,000) plus 1 full hosted day of public.telemetry_events (337,596 rows: 8 lifecycle events and 337,588 non-lifecycle heartbeat/infrastructure_health events through ingested_seq=14,047,596).

residual_findings_outside_scope.finding: Executes `DROP INDEX trade_journey_projection.idx_event_receipts_ingested_seq` without `IF EXISTS` after `ProjectionStore(runtime, bootstrap=True)` has already applied `002_drop_redundant_event_receipts_index.sql` and dropped that index. When run with TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL and TEST_PROJECTION_CONTAINER set, line 265 should use `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS` or target `idx_event_receipts_tenant_env_journey`.
residual_findings_outside_scope.proposed_register_class: RC3 / WP3.1 trade_journey receipt index cleanup follow-up
